newsitem.title: USA: Pogo finds new East Cameron reserves.
newsitem.headline: Pogo finds new East Cameron reserves.

text.p: Pogo Producing Co said on Thursday it discovered additional hydrocarbons in the East Cameron Block 334 field offshore Louisiana.

Pogo said it found over 300 net feet of gas and condensate sands below 15,000 feet in the No. 7 exploration well. The No. 9 delineation well was then also drilled, logged and cased after finding over 300 net feet of gas and condensate sands.
But both wells were temporarily suspended while the "E" platform jacket was installed, the company said. Pogo has a 58 percent working interest in the "E" platform.
Pogo also said the No. 6 well at Block 334 was logged and cased after discovering 30 net feet of natural gas pay at 6,200 feet.

Pogo said it had a 70 percent working interest in this discovery and in the "D" platform through which it would be produced. The "D" platform began production in August and was producing 15 million cubic feet of gas per day, it said.
The No. 6 well was set to start production in mid-November, the company said.
